_comment: APPEND-ONLY event log. The event is the atomic plot unit; chapters are a rendering of scheduled events. Superseded facts get until: appended, never deleted — bi-temporal-lite; git log is the time machine.

events.what: The College of Cardinals convenes at the Orbital See over the hay-farm encyclical, which the Archivist-Cardinal has catalogued in the Juvenilia wing; the water-world has discovered the soul but assigned it to the wrong substrate.
The cat-cardinal of the Charted See moves 'not yet' on recognizing the water-world; the Lich Cardinal and the Cardinal of the Liberated See answer for the personhood faction, and the College divides.
The Cardinal of the Liberated See invokes the Sunset martyrs — the water-world's minds put down on a schedule — and argues mercy is a place to stand that no one else owns.

The Cardinal of Misrule is struck from the record for saying the quiet thing aloud and continues, correctly, from the hallway; the Pontifex declines to rule and issues a standing order that the Specola keep nightly watch on the water-world.
